item.title: GNOME Foundation Board President
item.description:
Overview

President of the GNOME Foundation Board, providing governance and strategic direction for one of the largest open source desktop communities in the world. The role combines community leadership, organizational stewardship, and advocacy for free software.

Responsibilities

  • Board leadership — presiding over board meetings and guiding strategic discussions
  • Governance — participating in board decisions on foundation policy, budget, and strategic priorities
  • Community leadership — representing the interests of GNOME contributors, users, and the broader ecosystem
  • Fundraising & sustainability — supporting the foundation’s financial health through fundraising initiatives and donor relations
  • Advocacy — promoting GNOME and free software at conferences, in the press, and across the open source ecosystem
  • Community health — helping shape programs that support contributors, engagement, and inclusivity

Impact

  • Contributing to the governance of a foundation that supports GNOME’s worldwide contributor community
  • Strengthening the connection between the foundation, its projects, and the wider open source ecosystem
  • Helping ensure the long-term sustainability of GNOME through sound organizational leadership

item.title: GNOME Ambassador Program
item.description:
Overview

Building the GNOME Ambassador Program — a community initiative to empower local ambassadors worldwide to represent GNOME in their regions, organize local events, and grow the ecosystem through personal connections.

Program Goals

  • Local representation — enabling GNOME advocates to represent the project in their own communities and languages
  • Community growth — building regional communities that welcome new contributors and users
  • Outreach — supporting ambassadors in organizing local events, meetups, and educational activities
  • Onboarding — helping newcomers find their way into the GNOME community through local, trusted connections
  • Global reach — extending GNOME’s presence beyond the usual conference circuit into regional communities

My Role

Leading the design and rollout of the program: defining the ambassador role, building the application and onboarding process, establishing expectations and support structures, and coordinating with the GNOME Engagement Team.

item.title: GNOME Internship Programs
item.description:
Program Overview

Coordinating GNOME’s participation in outreachy and Google Summer of Code internship programs, connecting aspiring contributors with mentors and meaningful projects.

Key Activities

  • Recruiting and onboarding mentors
  • Reviewing and approving project proposals
  • Supporting interns throughout their journey
  • Organizing intern presentations and showcases

Impact

  • Approved projects that GNOME will spend $5k per internship 2x YoY.
  • Coordinated with the board to approve internships
  • Improved the internship experience and reduce mentorship burnout

item.title: GNOME Foundation Fundraising
item.description:
Project Overview

Supporting the GNOME Foundation’s fundraising efforts through structural guidance and mentorship — helping shape how the organization approaches sustainable funding.

My Role

  • Structural guidance — advising on fundraising structure and approach
  • Mentorship — mentoring those driving the fundraising work
  • Board perspective — helping coordinate which areas need effective fundraising, from the board’s vantage point

Note

Current focus area alongside board service — the day-to-day campaign execution is led by others; my contribution is strategic and advisory.

item.title: GNOME Engagement Team
item.description:
Project Overview

Leading the GNOME Engagement Team involves coordinating various community initiatives, helping organizing events, engaging with social media, and fostering relationships with contributors worldwide.

Key Responsibilities

  • Coordinating community outreach programs
  • Managing contributor onboarding processes
  • Developing engagement strategies
  • Educating the public on GNOME technologies
  • Build rapport with users around the world through local community ambassadors
  • Mediate disputes/issues/communications within GNOME project issues

My responsibilities

  • Lead the engagement team, and specificaly the “hospitality” team.
    • That manages the contributor process
    • Create material for the team to use in social media
    • Mediate issues within the project.
